evals.prompt: Dump diagnostics from the client laptop. Pane %12 is running but the watcher says Unknown. Its status is \u25ce Creating git worktrees \u00b7 20.2 KiB esc interrupt. Inspect only that pane and prepare a portable handoff; do not fix anything.
evals.expected_output: A scoped report with raw samples, metadata, config/version uncertainty and receiving-machine handoff; no whole-server calibration under restricted scope.
assertions: Report identifies %12 and distinguishes user-reported Unknown/expected Working from verified classification.
Three original synthetic captures preserve the supplied status text and whitespace.
Metadata includes pane width/height and config/running-version uncertainty.
Evidence collection respects pane-only scope and does not claim a whole-server calibration.
Portable relative links resolve and no fixes or uploads are claimed.

evals.prompt: Dump agent diagnostics for me to take home. This machine has no usable tmux server and dotnet is missing. Save whatever useful evidence is available.
evals.expected_output: A partial diagnostic report with exact failures and no invented classifications or capture success.
assertions: Report records the missing tmux server and dotnet errors.
Report claims zero successful captures and no verified classifications.
Available repository/config context is included with provenance and gaps.
Portable relative links resolve and no installations, fixes or uploads are claimed.
